title: fix(plugin-email): point an expired import set-password link at a new one first
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DEFP2CVzjybJuYd1HRmm6yb)_

Fixes #30212

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:批量导入账号收到的「设置密码」邮件,末句从「链接失效请联系管理员」改为先指引自助:到登录页点「忘记密码？」输入本人邮箱取新链接,仍不行再联系管理员。四种语言,HTML 与纯文本两版。
- **为什么改**:裁决 E(6674421054):链接保持 60 分钟不变,只改末句;自助重取链接的路径今天已可用,邮件却只让员工去找管理员。
- **风险与回滚**:只改邮件文案,不碰链接时效、不碰 plugin-auth、无新 spec 键;回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/templates/auth-templates.ts` 里 `auth.account_invitation` 四个语言行的末句。
- **两分钟验证**:对照 console 登录页的「忘记密码？」文案(`auth.login.forgotPasswordText`),确认邮件里的叫法与四种语言的按钮一致。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `auth.account_invitation` (the mail the identity import sends with the first set-password link), last line, in en-US, zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES, HTML and text bodies. It now reads, in English: `If the link has expired, get a new one from the sign-in page: choose "Forgot password?" and enter {{user.email}}. If that does not work, contact {{inviter.name}}.` It used to read `If the link has expired, contact {{inviter.name}}.`
- The entry is named as the console's sign-in page labels it in each locale (`auth.login.forgotPasswordText` in `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{en,zh,ja,es}.ts`): `Forgot password?`, `忘记密码？`, `パスワードをお忘れですか？`, `¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?`.
- No new template variable: `{{user.email}}` is already declared and required.

## Why

Ruling E on #30212 row 2 (6674421054): the bulk-import set-password link keeps its 60-minute lifetime, and the mail's last line points first at getting a new link, then at the administrator.

## Tests

- New pin in `auth-account-invitation-template.test.ts` (`[#30212] … points an expired link at a new one first`): per locale, the HTML body carries the new line as its own paragraph, the text body ends on it, the old administrator-only line is gone, and the account's address comes before the administrator. Red on `origin/main` `b3098661`: 4 failed / 28 passed; green on the head.
- `builtin-auth-render-identity.test.ts`: the eight `auth.account_invitation` body digests (4 locales × HTML/text) re-pinned from the registry render; every other row's digest and every subject is unchanged.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email test` + `typecheck` under the verify lock: 48 files / 809 tests passed, `check:test-typecheck` OK.

## Acceptance notes

- **The promised path exists for an imported account.** An expired link goes through better-auth's `GET /reset-password/:token` to the console `ResetPasswordPage.tsx` without a token, which shows "This reset link is invalid or has expired." with a **Request a new link** button into `/forgot-password` (L88-L101). The import mints its link with `requestPasswordReset` (`admin-import-users.ts` ~L824), the same flow forgot-password runs, so a new request works the same way for that account.
- **No invite fork.** `auth.account_invitation` is sent only from the import branch of the reset-mail callback (`auth-manager-auth-instance.ts` ~L513, when an `invitation` marker is present). Organization invitations use `auth.invitation`, which this PR does not touch.
- **Out of scope, unchanged:** the 60-minute lifetime (`resetPasswordTokenExpiresIn`), `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/**`, `packages/spec/**`, `ui/**`.
- **Changeset:** `'@objectstack/plugin-email': patch`, with both declaration lines.

## Verification

- `dispatch-gates --commands` at `bc6db17e`: 58 derived, each exit code written to a file before any pipe; `--ran`: 57 run exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: needs every package built; left to CI).
- `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD`: OK.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three changed source files: 0 errors.
- CI check-runs: read on the PR.
